_doc: Fixtures for .harmony/probe-outputs.sh (s-rta-0927 outputs-c1 = plan5 slice C1: the composition canvas copied into shared IOSurface frames that every output window presents; .harmony/.reports/s-rta-0926b/plan5-final.md 10.2). @MEDIA@ is replaced at run time with the checkout's media/ dir. NO row opens an output window: the frame path is exercised offscreen through a private CGL context (8080 /api/output_probe) with the tap forced on (8080 /api/set_output_tap). Assertions: the docstring of .harmony/probe-outputs.py. Fixture B (imageB, media/P16_02_Screen_Split_2x2.png, 756x878) is ITSELF a 2x2 grid of four copies on a #0F0F0F = (15,15,15) frame (a Screen Split still): a B frame shows that grid and grey edge at every canvas size; compare a B frame only with a B reference, never with an A frame.

portrait._why: output_probe 1080x1920 of the 1920x1080 canvas: the picture is fitCanvas(1920,1080,1080,1920) = {0,656,1080,607} (GL rows, bottom-up) = PNG rows 657..1263; rows outside are the bars.

change._why: trigger col1 = B; the probe must follow (LIVE, not a stale slot): d(probe, f0) > minDiff and d(probe, f_B) <= matchTol. d(A, B) at 1920x1080 is 29.4 (measured with PIL).

resolution._why: col0 = A is triggered first (the change row leaves B showing), then 8080 set_composition_params 1280x720; the canvas is re-allocated (a new frame generation); the 720p render_frame is one full-bleed A: d(f_720, imageA stretched to 1280x720 bilinear) <= contentTol (0.013 measured on main, .harmony/.reports/s-rta-0927/canvas720-diag.md); a 1920x1080 probe of the 720p canvas = the 720p render_frame upscaled (bilinear), within tol.

soak._why: the cross-thread / cross-context race soak: repeated probes while the main renders static A; every PNG decodes, none blank, all within matchTol of f0.

tapCost._why: REPORT only: 7070 /api/state frame_time_ms / peak_frame_time_ms / gpu_time_ms over `seconds` with the tap off, then on, at each canvas size. Runs only when no clang/clang++ is running; the load average is printed.
